scope: Image-only diagnostic, all Doop source bytes equal HEAD; external tree has only diagnostic workflow, not an acceptance/CI substitution; real index/source/HEAD unchanged
workflow:
name: Plan03 Doop image diagnostic
on: push
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Prepare the pinned managed source
        run: python3 scripts/doop-test.py setup --managed --directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/doop"
      - name: Build the actual private image and retain build errors
        run: |
          if ! python3 scripts/doop-test.py image --managed --directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/doop" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/doop-image"; then
            for log in build.log load.log; do
              if test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/doop-image/$log"; then
                cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/doop-image/$log"
              fi
            done
            exit 1
          fi
